# Clinical scoring, unseen people (generated by scripts/clinical.py)

Every signal is delineated with neurokit2 'dwt' at the database's R-peak marks. Intervals are compared beat by beat with the real ECG's delineation; real_ecg's own row shows the delineator against itself (zero by construction). Seeded rows averaged over 3 seeds per person, then over 16 people.

## Interval errors (ms) and how often the delineator finds each wave

*_beat_mae: median per-beat |output - real|. *_median_err: |the person's median interval in the output - in the real ECG|. *_found: fraction of beats with a plausible interval. p_agree: fraction of beats where output and real agree on whether there is a P wave.

## Person-by-person

- qrs_ms_beat_mae: unet lower than avg_beat for 10 of 15 people; mean difference -9.7 ms; Wilcoxon p = 0.359
- qrs_ms_beat_mae: unet_finetune_30s lower than unet for 15 of 16 people; mean difference -34.5 ms; Wilcoxon p = 0.000775

- qt_ms_beat_mae: unet_finetune_30s lower than unet for 15 of 16 people; mean difference -37.3 ms; Wilcoxon p = 0.00053

## Flat-line test: what each model draws from inputs with no heartbeat

One minute of input per fold and seed (zeros; white noise; the real SCG cut into 50 ms blocks and shuffled; the real SCG for reference). beats_per_min: R-peaks neurokit finds in the output. out_sd: output SD (the real ECG target has SD 1).
